topics.title: 课程作业与考核规范
topics.summary: 卡塔尔大学校长令明文禁止依赖生成式AI代写课程作业、研究论文或学位论文，确保学生独立学术产出。
topics.scope: 校长办公室官方AI使用指令
topics.evidenceScope: Office of the President official AI instructions

claims.text: Official presidential instructions mandate refraining from relying on generative AI to write assignments or research papers on students' behalf.

evidence.quote: Academic integrity: Refraining from relying on generative artificial intelligence in writing research papers, assignments, or theses on behalf of students or researchers.
evidence.title: Instructions on The Use of Generative AI Tools at Qatar University

topics.title: 考试与考场纪律
topics.statusLabel: 个人承担完全学术责任
topics.summary: 校内人员对在平时考核或考试中经AI辅助生成的任何内容承担完全且独立的个人责任。
topics.scope: 校内成员考核完全问责条款

claims.text: Institutional policy holds university affiliates fully and individually accountable for all content produced or used in assessment.

evidence.quote: Accountability: The University affiliate remains fully responsible for the content produced or used with the assistance of generative artificial intelligence tools.
evidence.title: Instructions on The Use of Generative AI Tools at Qatar University

topics.title: AI使用声明与披露
topics.statusLabel: 须披露使用范围与贡献度
topics.summary: 指引要求披露生成式AI在学术、研究或行政工作中的使用，并说明范围和程度，包括贡献比例或水平。
topics.scope: 强制性透明度与贡献度披露规范

claims.text: The instructions call for disclosure of generative AI use in academic, research or administrative work, including its scope and extent such as the percentage or level of contribution.

evidence.quote: Transparency: Disclosure of any use of generative artificial intelligence tools in the preparation of academic or research work or administrative outputs, and clarification of the scope and extent (including the percentage/level of contribution).
evidence.title: Instructions on The Use of Generative AI Tools at Qatar University

topics.title: 隐私与数据保护
topics.summary: 指引要求使用者避免将个人、机密或敏感数据输入生成式AI工具，以保障数据隐私。
topics.scope: 校级与国家个人数据保护条款
topics.evidenceScope: Institutional and national data protection controls

claims.text: Guidelines instruct users to avoid inputting personal, confidential, or sensitive data into generative AI tools.

evidence.quote: Protection of privacy: Avoiding the input of any personal, confidential, and sensitive data into artificial intelligence tools or platforms to maintain the confidentiality of personal and sensitive information and the protection of privacy.
evidence.title: Instructions on The Use of Generative AI Tools at Qatar University

topics.title: 认可与支持的AI工具
topics.summary: 卡塔尔大学AI创新中心列出包括GPU虚拟机和托管AI平台在内的计算资源；统一商业平台使用资格尚未核实。
topics.scope: 高性能计算与GPU科研资源
topics.evidenceScope: High-performance computing and GPU research resources

claims.text: Qatar University’s AI Innovation Hub lists computing resources including GPU virtual machines and managed AI platforms.

evidence.quote:
Access Qatar University's AI Innovation Hub computing resources—dedicated VMs
with GPUs, fully managed AI platforms, and serverless data analytics.
evidence.title: Available Resources (QU AI Innovation Hub)

topics.title: 科研与论文署名
topics.statusLabel: 严查事实准确性与偏见
topics.summary: 科研人员在公开发表前必须对所有AI生成内容进行严格的人工事实核实与去偏见审查，确保科研准确性。
topics.scope: 科学研究尽职审查与去偏见标准

claims.text: Researchers must rigorously review generated outputs to verify accuracy, eliminate bias, and uphold publication ethics.

evidence.quote:
Accuracy and diligence: Reviewing outputs generated by generative artificial intelligence
   tools, verifying their accuracy and validity, being free from bias, and ensuring their
   appropriateness before use or publication.
evidence.title: Instructions on The Use of Generative AI Tools at Qatar University

additionalTopics.title: 学术诚信与违规处理
additionalTopics.statusLabel: 依校纪与网络安全法追责
additionalTopics.summary: 指引提醒成员在使用AI时须遵守相关法律规范与学术标准；学生守则中的具体违规处分等级与正式申诉流程属于未核实缺口。
additionalTopics.scope: 学生行为守则与国家法规衔接
additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Student code of conduct and national law

claims.text: AI guidance reminds university affiliates to adhere to applicable legislative instruments and academic integrity principles; specific Student Code sanctions remain an unverified gap.

evidence.quote:
Compliance with regulations: Adhering to relevant legislative instruments related to
   cybersecurity, scientific research standards, and publication ethics.
evidence.title: Instructions on The Use of Generative AI Tools at Qatar University

additionalTopics.title: 教学实践原则
additionalTopics.summary: 校级指引确立了适用于大学成员的基本原则；各学院的具体实施细则及强制性教学大纲模板属于未核实缺口。
additionalTopics.scope: 覆盖全校各部门的校长令框架

claims.text: Institutional AI principles apply generally to university affiliates; mandatory college-level curriculum requirements remain an unverified gap.

evidence.quote:
These instructions apply to all University affiliates and cover all aspects of the use of generative
artificial intelligence tools in teaching activities, scientific research, administrative work, technical
services, and student services
evidence.title: Instructions on The Use of Generative AI Tools at Qatar University

additionalTopics.title: 安全合规与采购
additionalTopics.summary: 商业云服务采购合同与校级软件技术评估文件未在本地抓取提取物中核实。
additionalTopics.evidenceGap: Commercial purchasing approvals and vendor contracts for proprietary cloud services were not verified in local crawl extractions; pending independent source verification.
